mapper.sql: p.product_seq, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category_seq, p.brand_seq, p.status, p.origin_country, p.produced_on, p.cost_amount, p.season, p.release_year, p.sort_order, p.use_yn, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at, c.category_id AS category_id, c.category_name AS category_name, CONCAT_WS(' > ', c2.category_name, c1.category_name, c.category_name) AS category_path, b.brand_id AS brand_id, b.brand_name AS brand_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_sku s WHERE s.product_seq = p.product_seq) AS sku_count

FROM tb_product p JOIN tb_category c ON c.category_seq = p.category_seq LEFT JOIN tb_category c1 ON c1.category_seq = c.parent_seq LEFT JOIN tb_category c2 ON c2.category_seq = c1.parent_seq JOIN tb_brand b ON b.brand_seq = p.brand_seq

where.if: AND ( LOWER(p.product_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_product WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_product SET product_name = #{productName}, category_seq = #{categorySeq}, brand_seq = #{brandSeq}, status = #{status}, origin_country = #{originCountry}, produced_on = #{producedOn}, cost_amount = #{costAmount}, season = #{season}, release_year = #{releaseYear}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_seq = #{productSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_sku WHERE product_seq = #{productSeq}
